guitar.notes: Tom Scholz is known for Gibson Les Pauls run through his own Rockman gear; fairly well known but not as singularly iconic as e.g. Slash's, so medium fits.

tone.target: bright layered hard-rock lead with smooth sustain
tone.profile: bright layered hard-rock lead with smooth sustain
tone.summary: A polished 70s arena rock lead tone using a Marshall-style preamp (UK SLP) for brightness and sustain, paired with a classic 4x12 cabinet. Delay is used subtly to enhance the wide, singing feel.
corrections: lean more arena than pop rock

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain leads and eliminate hum.
Slightly lift the signal and enhance upper mids for lead clarity.
blocks.gap: Using Boost to simulate a clean boost pedal effect, enhancing sustain without adding grit.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary hard-rock grit and sustain without sounding overly muddy or dark.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model provides a versatile, high-headroom gain suitable for 70s arena rock lead tones.

alternatives.model: RAT-style (if more aggressive grit is needed)

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, powerful British stack sound characteristic of 70s arena rock.

alternatives.model: UK 45 (if a slightly more vintage/less aggressive tone is desired)

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic, bright British cabinet sound matching the era and genre.

alternatives.model: Mess 4x12 (for a slightly more modern/open feel)

blocks.purpose: Enhance the upper mids and high frequencies to achieve 'bright upper mids' and cut through the mix.

alternatives.model: Guitar EQ 1 (if less aggressive shaping is needed)

blocks.purpose: Used as a subtle stereo widening effect (though the verdict advises against Chorus, it is useful for 'wide stereo feel' and can be kept minimal).
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly avoids chorus. This module is included only to address the 'wide stereo feel' requirement while keeping settings extremely subtle.

blocks.purpose: Provide a tight, noticeable delay to enhance the 'singing sustain' and wide feel without sounding wash-out.
Add a polished 'arena sheen' and natural space without muddying the lead tone.

improvements.summary: Refine cabinet and EQ for maximum 70s arena brightness and sustain.

proposals.reason: Enhance the classic, bright British stack sound for arena sheen.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and punch in upper mids.

proposals.reason: Maximize the 'bright upper mids' required for lead clarity and cut.
proposals.expectedGain: More defined presence and sparkle in the mix.
